name: Camping/Wohnmobilstellplatz Hotel Krimmlerfälle
beschreibung: The campsite and motorhome pitch at Hotel Krimmlerfälle is located in Tirol, not far from the famous Krimmler Wasserfälle. The site offers hardstanding pitches for motorhomes and tents with electricity hookups. Guests can use the sanitary facilities and the on-site restaurant. Direct hiking trails to Europe's highest waterfalls start from here. The site serves as a base camp for excursions in the Nationalpark Hohe Tauern. A reception and a small shop are available.
